Puzzle 962. Claudio Meller 1519 entry.

Problems & Puzzles: Puzzles

Puzzle 962. Claudio Meller 1519 entry.

Claudio Meller in his entry 1519 ask for a larger solution than this one

59 x 2 + 59 + 2 = 179 Primo

59 x 3 + 59 + 3 = 239 Primo

59 x 5 + 59 + 5 = 359 Primo

59 x 7 + 59 + 7 = 479 Primo

59 x 11 + 59 + 11 = 719 Primo

59 x 13 + 59 + 13 = 839 Primo

The fixed prime is 59 and the variable primes are 2, 3, ... 13

A larger solutions means here more than 6 rows. The variable primes need to be consecutive but not necessarily starting in 2.

I found this one larger solution (9 rows)

3378469499 = 10709 * 315449 + 10709 + 315449

3378490919 = 10709 * 315451 + 10709 + 315451

3378598019 = 10709 * 315461 + 10709 + 315461

3378662279 = 10709 * 315467 + 10709 + 315467

3378812219 = 10709 * 315481 + 10709 + 315481

3378940739 = 10709 * 315493 + 10709 + 315493

3379197779 = 10709 * 315517 + 10709 + 315517

3379240619 = 10709 * 315521 + 10709 + 315521

3379304879 = 10709 * 315527 + 10709 + 315527

Q. Send your largest solution (more than 9 rows).

Contributions came from Emmanuel Vantieghem, Shyam Sunder Gupta, Giovanni Resta, Simon Cavegn, Oscar Volpatti
